title: Forethought Solve Conversation
description: A Solve conversation between an end-user and the Forethought Solve agent.

user_id.description: Stable identifier for the end user.

query.description: The customer's free-form question or statement.

is_solved.description: True when the conversation has been resolved by Solve.

should_escalate.description: True when Solve recommends escalating to a human agent.

workflow_id.description: Identifier of the matched Autoflow / workflow.

context_variables.description: Map of Solve context variable IDs to their values for this conversation.
